local.hint: Labels: job, level. JSON lines with log_level and message.

dev.description: asva2 DEV stand: Kubernetes, Loki 2.6.1, read-only ingress
dev.hint: Kubernetes, Loki 2.6.1. Start with {namespace=~"dev|asv-dev"}. On this stand instance names helm releases (ssj-main for ССЖ); applicationName may be absent. For errors use a line filter such as |= "ERROR". To follow an id across services, omit the service matcher and add |= "taskExecutionId=13548" or the error id. For one user, search the JSON line text with |= "\"userId\":\"11952\"". Stack trace frames may be separate lines without a level.

tst.description: asva2 TST stand: docker-compose on the infra host, Loki 3.5, 7-day retention
tst.hint: Docker, Loki 3.x, quiet outside ССЖ; widen the window before concluding that a service is silent. Start with {job="docker"}. The service label or container names a service; for errors try | detected_level="error" or |= "ERROR". Search a task or error id across services with a line filter on {job="docker"}. Stack trace frames may be separate lines without a level.

secured.description: Loki behind authentication, configured through environment variables
